preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is not greater than 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only digits and decimal points.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s if c.isalpha())
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only lowercase English letters for the names of the purchases.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in s if c.isdigit() or c == '.')
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only digits and decimal points for the prices of the purchases.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < len(name) <= 10 for name in re.findall(r'[a-z]+', s))
preconditions.description: Each name of the purchases in the input string s has a length not less than 1 and not greater than 10.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < len(price) <= 10 for price in re.findall(r'\d+\.\d{2}', s))
preconditions.description: Each price of the purchases in the input string s has a length not less than 1 and not greater than 10.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string.
The output string contains exactly three decimal points.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in output if c != '.')
postconditions.description: The output string contains only digits and decimal points.
The output string is the total price of all purchases in the same format as the input.
